study_status: Retrospective extension; previously examined139-bottle cohort; no new external validation
target_weighting: All eleven endpoints equally weighted after receiving-training response variance standardization
freeze_rule: Fix code/configuration/endpoints before this retrospective run. Retain all targets, masks and negative results. Do not tune on outer outcomes or call this cohort new validation.
physical_preprocessing_scope: Numerical sensitivity candidates; source units and instrument settings still require record confirmation. No water or ethanol subtraction or hard cropping.
panel_scope: Shared acquisition subset. Tolerances are predictive-error sensitivities, not clinically or analytically justified noninferiority margins.
sopls_scope: Single-response SO-PLS with all block orders and uniform declared components perblock; same physical preprocessing options as other algorithms. Total latent dimension can differ across masks.
